prompt: gouache painted video game concept art, hand painted matte textures, soft flat lighting, muted earthy palette, clean readable shapes, painterly brushwork
negative_prompt: photograph, photorealistic, text, watermark, signature, blurry, extra objects, cluttered background, distorted geometry, duplicated shapes, fisheye
notes: The M3 real style (KB Decision 31: one real style, every path style-keyed). Control signal is the dataset's own exported depth buffer, not an estimated depth map. strength/controlnet_conditioning_scale were 0.65/1.0 in the first full run: that failed the hallucination gate on 39 frames, all of them in the moving-camera window. 0.45/1.3 is the measured knee — it fixes every one of those (spurious 0.545 -> 0.000 on the worst frame) while keeping ~80% of the stylisation magnitude. Going further to 0.35/1.5 also passes but trades away more restyling for alignment we already have; see KB Decision 32. Licences: SD 1.5 CreativeML OpenRAIL-M, ControlNet Apache-2.0.
